confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chinese provincial-capital price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by district and season, and July is peak domestic travel season. The FX observation comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page directly, and a 15 October value may be provisional because the RBA publishes after 4.00 pm on weekdays.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable mid-sized Chinese provincial capitals with similar domestic-tourism price levels (e.g., Hangzhou, Wuhan, Chengdu). No single named source was used for the city anchors.
